settings.extension_rule: Run a matched 4200-step constant-target comparison for all profiles of an algorithm only if balanced_aligned reduces final balanced objective from its own initial value in >=2/3 seeds and beats baseline mean final balanced objective at 1050 steps.
settings.glide_rule: Train glide only after >=2/3 seeds of one aligned constant-target cohort achieve final legacy error <=0.08; otherwise generate glide oracle and baselines without claiming RL validation.
